# IBM Db2 TechX Summit 2026 — Project Submission

> **PR Title Format:** `[Submission] kisan-mitra: (किसान मित्र) - Bilingual AI Assistant for Indian Farmers (IBM Db2 12.1+)`
> **Folder Format:** `submissions/kisan-mitra/`

---

## 1. Project Overview

- **Project Title:** Kisan Mitra (किसान मित्र) - Bilingual AI Assistant for Indian Farmers
- **Project Slug:** `submissions/kisan-mitra/`
- **Short Description:** A bilingual (Hindi/English) Agentic AI assistant built on LangChain and IBM Db2 12.1+. It delivers relational Text-to-SQL analytics over real Agmarknet mandi prices and native vector similarity search over official welfare scheme guidelines (PM-KISAN, PMFBY, KCC), featuring a dedicated 'Gramin Mitra' voice mode for illiterate farmers.
- **Problem Solved & Target Audience:** Solves daily mandi price opacity and bureaucratic scheme guideline complexity for over 140 million Indian agricultural households, particularly illiterate and neo-literate farmers who require local dialect voice assistance.

---

## 2. Team Information

- **Team Name:** Kisan Mitra
- **Team Members:**

| Full Name | GitHub Username | Email / Role |
|---|---|---|
| Priyanshi Verma | @priyanshiverma1209 | Lead AI & Database Developer |

---

## 3. IBM Db2 Integration Summary

- **IBM Db2 Edition / Environment:** IBM Db2 Community Edition 12.1.2.0 (Docker container) + High-fidelity emulation dual-engine client.
- **How IBM Db2 is Used in the Solution:** 
  1. Relational Analytics (`MANDI_PRICES`): Agmarknet commodity arrivals, dynamic date arithmetic (`CURRENT DATE - 7 DAYS`), and aggregations.
  2. Native Vector Search (`DOC_CHUNKS`): In-database `VECTOR(384, REAL)` with `SYSIBM.VECTOR_DISTANCE(..., COSINE)` for hallucination-free RAG with page citations—zero external vector databases.
- **Db2 Connector / Driver / Framework Integration Used:** `ibm_db` (v3.2.3), `ibm_db_sa`, `SQLAlchemy` (v2.0), LangChain 0.3.
- **Schema & Data Stored / Processed:** `MANDI_PRICES` (daily arrivals, min, max, modal prices with B-Tree composite indexes), `DOC_CHUNKS` (scheme PDFs page chunks with 384-dim dense vectors).
- **Steps to Verify Db2 Integration:** Run `pytest tests/` (35 automated unit, safety, and benchmark tests passing) or launch `./run.sh` and inspect the live SQL Query Inspector.

---

## 4. Technology Stack & AI / LLM Usage

- **Programming Languages:** Python 3.12, SQL, HTML5 / JavaScript
- **Frameworks & Libraries:** LangChain 0.3, Streamlit 1.42, Plotly 6.0, Pandas 2.2, PyArrow 17.0, gTTS 2.5
- **AI / LLM Framework:** LangChain (Intent Router, SQL Agent, Vector RAG Agent, Gramin Mitra Simplifier)
- **Model Provider & Model Name:** Google Gemini 2.5 Flash / watsonx.ai (swappable) + local multilingual sentence-transformers (`paraphrase-multilingual-MiniLM-L12-v2` 384d)
- **Where AI/LLM is Applied in the Workflow:** Query intent classification, natural language to IBM Db2 SQL generation, vector semantic context synthesis, and rural chaupal dialect simplification.

---

## 5. Demonstration & Links

- **Live Demo URL:** Local Streamlit Dashboard (`http://localhost:8501`) via `./run.sh`
- **Demo Video Script:** `submissions/kisan-mitra/DEMO_SCRIPT.md` (2-3 minute presentation guide)
- **External Source Repo:** https://github.com/priyanshiverma1209/IBM_Db2_TechX_Project_Submission
- **Presentation / Slides URL:** `submissions/kisan-mitra/docs/Kisan_Mitra_IBM_Db2_Presentation.pptx` (Interactive 12-slide deck)

---

## 6. Submission Verification Checklist

Please verify and check every item before requesting review:

- [x] **Folder Structure:** My submission is placed in a single new directory under `submissions/<project-slug>/` copied from `submissions/_template/`.
- [x] **Naming Conventions:** The `<project-slug>` uses lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens only, matching the branch name and PR title.
- [x] **Complete Documentation:** Both `submissions/<project-slug>/README.md` and `submissions/<project-slug>/architecture.md` are completely filled out without unfilled placeholder markers.
- [x] **Metadata File:** `submissions/<project-slug>/submission.json` is completed and valid JSON.
- [x] **No Secrets or Credentials:** No API keys, passwords, private tokens, or connection strings with real credentials are committed. `.env.example` contains placeholders only.
- [x] **Tested Setup Instructions:** Setup and run instructions were tested from a fresh environment and can be reproduced by reviewers.
- [x] **License Declared:** Open-source license or distribution terms are specified (GODL-India).
- [x] **Code of Conduct:** All team members agree to adhere to the repository Code of Conduct.
- [x] **Scope Isolation:** This PR only adds/modifies files inside `submissions/<project-slug>/` and does not touch root files or other submissions.
- [x] **Google Form Submission:** I understand that opening this PR is step 1, and I will submit this PR URL into the official Google Form.

---

## 7. Additional Notes for Reviewers & Judges

- Includes **Gramin Mitra (ग्रामीण मित्र)** — a dedicated AI audio mode with in-browser speech synthesis tailored for illiterate and neo-literate farmers.
- 100% verified with 35 automated test cases in `tests/` covering AST safety, relational SQL, native vector distance, and audio generation.
